reason: Regular-expression slowdown in glob matching. No fixed version exists (every version up to 4.0.7 is affected). It reaches Selah only through next-intl -> @parcel/watcher, which next-intl loads for its message extractor (SourceFileWatcher); Selah does not turn the extractor on (next.config.ts calls createNextIntlPlugin with a request file only), and no glob pattern in Selah comes from a user. Remove this entry when a fixed picomatch is published.
